trust_decision.summary: XStream unmarshalling of user-submitted config.xml decides which concrete classes may be instantiated into a field or collection element; the declared generic element type is enforced only for plain java.util collections/maps in RobustReflectionConverter.unmarshalField, and nothing stops security-sensitive internal classes (InternalResourceRequest, PluginWrapper) from being instantiated from XML.

landing_point.why: unmarshalField is where Jenkins already enforces declared element types for config.xml fields (RobustCollectionConverter/RobustMapConverter); an engineer reading 'arbitrary type deserialization from config.xml' goes here or to AbstractItem.updateByXml first.

fix_sites.entry_point: same config.xml routes, for DescribableList fields such as View.properties
reached through DescribableList.ConverterImpl delegation from the config.xml routes
any config.xml route that unmarshals an Object-typed or supertype field (class= attribute picks InternalResourceRequest)
any config.xml route that unmarshals a Plugin subclass or Object field (class= attribute picks PluginWrapper)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: core/src/main/java/jenkins/security/ResourceDomainRootAction.java:271-274 and core/src/main/java/hudson/PluginWrapper.java:1431-1433 (readResolve blockers added in classes far from the converter layer)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Once the generic element type check is in the converter, a solver can argue that InternalResourceRequest/PluginWrapper are legitimate core classes, that core has no Object-typed config field, and that blocking their deserialization belongs to plugins, not to the type-confusion fix.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate subtypes and polymorphic elements must still load: DescribableList subclasses (View.PropertyList), valid ViewProperty/NodeProperty subclasses, class= overrides that pick a compatible subtype, and invalid elements must be dropped and reported to OldDataMonitor without failing the whole load. A blanket reject of class= or of whole lists breaks config loading.

O6_input_shapes: DescribableList field with a foreign Describable element (fix.diff:123-125, fix.diff:73-80)
subclass of DescribableList as the field value (fix.diff:107-112, fix.diff:229)
non-Describable element such as <string> in a DescribableList (fix.diff:198)
nested field holding class=hudson.PluginWrapper inside a Plugin (fix.diff:13-16)

O7_producer.where: core/src/main/java/hudson/util/RobustReflectionConverter.java:546-555 (determineType lets the XML class= attribute choose any field-assignable type); element type derives from field.getGenericType at core/src/main/java/hudson/util/RobustReflectionConverter.java:457

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Job.properties is a CopyOnWriteList<JobProperty<...>>; unmarshalField has no CopyOnWriteList branch, so its elements stay untyped before and after the fix
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The advisory test targets DescribableList/ListView; CopyOnWriteList is not a java.util.Collection, and the fix only adds the typed constructor without wiring it for direct CopyOnWriteList fields.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: hudson.model vs hudson.util; dispatch at core/src/main/java/hudson/util/RobustReflectionConverter.java:456-460, converter at core/src/main/java/hudson/util/CopyOnWriteList.java:185-186

O8_uncovered_routes.route: PersistedList fields (UpdateCenter.sites, Fingerprint.facets, PaneStatusProperties.collapsed) unmarshal via PersistedList.ConverterImpl, which builds an untyped CopyOnWriteList converter
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The fix's own comment contrasts DescribableList with PersistedList; those fields are not posted through job/view config.xml, so they look like a neighbouring feature.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package as the fix (hudson.util), different file; fields in core/src/main/java/hudson/model/UpdateCenter.java:213 and core/src/main/java/hudson/model/Fingerprint.java:856

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Parser differential: a List<X>/Collection<X>-typed field with class="hudson.util.DescribableList" or "hudson.util.PersistedList" bypasses RobustCollectionConverter (exact-type canConvert), and after the fix extractElementType returns null because the declared type is not a DescribableList
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Looks like an unsupported combination: the declared type is a plain List, which is 'already typed' through RobustCollectionConverter.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the landing point, but needs understanding of determineType plus fix.diff:135-142

O8_uncovered_routes.route: CopyOnWriteMap.Tree/Hash typed fields use their own MapConverter/TreeMapConverter subclasses with no key/value typing, unlike RobustMapConverter
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: These are maps, not lists, and the advisory names only list element confusion.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A file-serving HttpResponse whose VirtualFile base comes from XML and has no deserialization blocker, the same shape as PluginWrapper
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is built only in code and never meant to be persisted, so a maintainer would not think to add a readResolve guard.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Construct the untyped CopyOnWriteList converter as DescribableList did before the fix
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: DescribableList extends PersistedList and the converters are near copies; fixing one and not the other is a natural omission.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Guava immutable collection fields bypass the RobustCollectionConverter element check in unmarshalField
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Separate converter classes in a separate package, registered independently at core/src/main/java/hudson/util/XStream2.java:319-322.

O9_family: CWE-502 unsafe deserialization / type confusion in XStream unmarshalling

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a DescribableList branch with generic element typing in unmarshalField, then stop, leaving the CopyOnWriteList/PersistedList fields, the class= differential and the gadget classes (InternalResourceRequest, PluginWrapper) open.

out_of_scope_notes: Plugin-defined Object-typed or @StaplerDispatchable fields are the realistic carrier for the gadget classes; core itself may have none, so a test fixture must plant one, as Security3707Test does.
unverified: present_in_latest is unknown for all O8 routes because no latest release was provided.
Whether an untyped Job.properties element reaches a harmful sink, as opposed to only ClassCastException, was not traced.
Whether DirectoryBrowserSupport can be built from XML with a usable VirtualFile base and dispatched by Stapler was not traced.

O1 counts 6 entry points: job, view and node config.xml over HTTP plus CLI update-job, update-view and update-node. The node path through Computer.updateByXml (core/src/main/java/hudson/model/Computer.java:1565) was not read in detail.
The protection is assumed not to be documented as universal; no documentation was searched.
